About DHL Blue Dart Express India:

Blue Dart Express Limited, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000+ locations in India as well as internationally. Its competencies span across evaluation and contracting, planning and transition, delivery and execution, and specific service capabilities. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast-paced logistics environment and ever-evolving supply-chains. It wholly-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004. 

Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder. 

We are proud to be consistently ranked among India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an Employer of Choice is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.  

If you are looking to join a purpose-led, people-first, company that shapes India’s supply-chains with integrity and safety, Blue Dart is where you belong. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.  

Position Overview:

The Executive/Senior Executive – Sales Support – Branch is responsible for managing end-to-end billing, invoicing, and collections coordination for branch customers, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and adherence to contractual and company guidelines.

The role acts as a key interface between Sales, Finance, and Customers to ensure smooth revenue realization, effective dispute resolution, and strong process discipline at the branch level.

Job Purpose:

To ensure accurate and timely billing, efficient collections follow-up, and resolution of customer billing queries, thereby supporting revenue realization, improving receivables performance, and enhancing customer experience.

Key Roles & Responsibilities:

Billing & Invoicing Management


 Coordinate with Branch Finance & Accounts teams for timely bill generation Validate accuracy of invoices as per contractual terms and company norms Ensure customization of invoices as per customer agreements Ensure timely dispatch of invoices to customers


Collections & Receivables Management


 Work closely with Sales teams to ensure timely collections Follow up on pending, short, or delayed payments Track receivables ageing and escalate as per timelines Support improvement of DSO at branch level


Customer Query & Dispute Resolution


 Coordinate with Finance and Sales teams to resolve billing disputes Ensure closure of disputes before payment due dates Maintain proactive customer communication


Reporting & Governance


 Maintain billing, dispatch, and collection MIS Share reports with Branch Finance and Sales leadership Ensure adherence to SOPs, audit, and documentation standards


Sales & Branch Coordination


 Align billing cycles with contractual agreements Support onboarding of customers from billing readiness perspective Ensure coordination across Sales, Operations, and Finance


Process Discipline & Continuous Improvement


 Adhere to defined SOPs and processes Identify recurring issues and highlight to supervisor Suggest improvements to enhance accuracy and turnaround time Support automation and process improvement initiatives Apply learnings from errors and audit observations


People & Team Support


 Provide operational guidance to branch sales teams Ensure process adherence and performance discipline Support manpower planning inputs where required


Qualifications & Experience:

Education:


 Graduate in Commerce / Business Administration MBA preferred


Experience:


 2 – 4 years Experience in billing, invoicing, collections, or sales support roles Exposure to logistics / courier / B2B services preferred


Skills & Capabilities:

Technical Skills:


 Understanding of billing and invoicing processes Knowledge of receivables and collections management Proficiency in MS Excel and reporting tools Familiarity with ERP / billing systems


Key Competencies:


 Attention to detail Strong coordination and stakeholder management Customer orientation Problem-solving approach Ability to work under timelines


Key Performance Indicators:

KRAs

KPIs

Billing Timeliness

% invoices generated and dispatched within timelines

Billing Accuracy

Number of billing errors / rework cases

Collections Efficiency

% collections achieved within due dates

Receivables Control

Reduction in overdue receivables / ageing

Dispute Resolution

Turnaround time for closure of billing issues

Reporting & Compliance

Accuracy and timeliness of MIS

Stakeholder Coordination

Feedback from Sales / Finance teams

Process Improvement & Discipline

Reduction in recurring errors; adherence to SOPs

Position Overview:

The Territory Service Representative (TSR) – Operations is responsible for the timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within an assigned territory while delivering a superior customer experience and representing the Blue Dart brand with professionalism.

Operating as the face of Blue Dart on the ground, the role ensures safe handling of shipments, timely collections and deliveries, accurate shipment scanning, COD collections, proof of delivery (POD) compliance and adherence to operational procedures. The TSR works closely with the Shift In-charge and branch operations team to ensure service commitments are consistently achieved while maintaining the highest standards of safety, customer service and operational discipline.

Job Purpose:

To execute timely pickup and delivery of shipments, ensure accurate shipment handling, customer interactions and COD collections while adhering to Blue Dart's operational standards, safety requirements and service commitments.

Key Roles & Responsibilities:

Pickup & Delivery Operations


 Perform timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within the assigned route or territory. Ensure all shipments are delivered within committed service timelines. Verify shipment details before pickup and delivery. Handle shipments carefully to prevent damage or loss. Maintain delivery productivity and route efficiency.


Customer Service Excellence


 Serve as the face of Blue Dart during every customer interaction. Maintain courteous, professional and customer-centric behaviour at all times. Resolve basic customer queries during pickups and deliveries. Escalate customer concerns or operational exceptions promptly. Maintain high standards of grooming, behaviour and professionalism.


COD & Documentation Management


 Collect Cash on Delivery (COD) payments wherever applicable. Ensure accurate cash handling and timely remittance as per company procedures. Obtain Proof of Delivery (POD), customer acknowledgements and required shipment documentation. Ensure documentation accuracy and compliance with operational procedures. Report discrepancies immediately.


Operational Compliance


 Scan shipments accurately using handheld devices or approved digital platforms. Ensure shipment status updates are completed in real time. Follow all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) during pickup and delivery activities. Adhere to company policies relating to shipment handling, documentation and customer interaction. Support operational requirements during peak business periods.


Safety & Security


 Follow all road safety guidelines while operating company or personal vehicles. Ensure safe handling and security of customer shipments throughout transit. Wear the prescribed company uniform and personal protective equipment wherever applicable. Report accidents, incidents or unsafe conditions immediately. Protect company assets and customer property.


Vehicle & Asset Responsibility


 Maintain the assigned vehicle or personal two-wheeler in roadworthy condition. Ensure all statutory vehicle documents remain valid. Maintain cleanliness and basic upkeep of the vehicle. Report maintenance requirements promptly.


Workplace Discipline & Brand Representation


 Maintain high standards of personal grooming, hygiene and professional appearance. Wear the prescribed Blue Dart uniform and identity card while on duty. Demonstrate discipline, punctuality and professionalism at all times. Follow workplace rules, operational discipline and company policies. Represent the Blue Dart brand positively through behaviour, teamwork and commitment to service excellence.


Team Collaboration


 Work closely with Shift In-charges and branch operations teams. Support colleagues during operational contingencies. Participate in operational briefings and safety meetings. Contribute towards achieving branch productivity and service goals.


Qualifications & Experience:

Education:


 Minimum 10th Standard Pass. Higher educational qualifications will be an added advantage.


Experience:


 Fresher or up to 2 years of relevant experience in courier, logistics, distribution, retail delivery or field operations. Experience in pickup and delivery operations will be an added advantage.


Eligibility Requirements:


 Minimum age 18 years. Valid Two-Wheeler or Four-Wheeler Driving Licence. Must own a two-wheeler where deployment requires the employee to use a personal vehicle, in accordance with Company policy. Physically fit to perform field operations. Willingness to work across shifts, weekends and holidays based on business requirements.


Skills & Capabilities:

Technical Skills:


 Pickup & Delivery Operations Shipment Handling Cash Collection (COD) Proof of Delivery (POD) Mobile Device / Scanner Usage Route Familiarity Basic Computer & Mobile Application Skills Basic English Reading & Understanding

 Customer Focus Integrity Reliability Safety Consciousness Teamwork Discipline Time Management Accountability Positive Attitude Professional Appearance

Pickup & Delivery Operations

Ensure accurate handling, loading, transportation and delivery of customer shipments. Optimize daily route execution to maximize delivery productivity and customer coverage. Customer Service & Brand Representation


 Deliver an exceptional customer experience during every customer interaction. Professionally represent the Blue Dart brand while interacting with customers. COD & Documentation Management


 Collect and reconcile Cash on Delivery (COD) payments accurately. Ensure timely remittance of collections in accordance with company procedures. Obtain Proof of Delivery (POD) and complete all shipment documentation accurately. Ensure zero discrepancies in shipment documentation and cash handling. Maintain complete compliance with operational documentation requirements.


Operational Excellence

Strictly adhere to Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and operational guidelines. Identify operational issues and recommend improvements to enhance productivity.  Minimum age 18 years. Valid Two-Wheeler or Four-Wheeler Driving Licence. Must own a two-wheeler where deployment requires the employee to use a personal vehicle, in accordance with Company policy. Position Overview:

The Manager – Dangerous Goods (DG) Management is a specialised national-level role responsible for establishing and strengthening Blue Dart's Dangerous Goods management framework across its air and ground operations, ensuring regulatory compliance, safe shipment handling and effective prevention of undeclared or misdeclared dangerous goods entering the network.

Reporting to the Head – Safety, the position will serve as the organisation's technical subject-matter expert for Dangerous Goods classification, identification, acceptance, interception, transportation, spill management and safe disposal. A key priority will be to reduce DG-related interceptions by airlines through stronger preventive controls, operational procedures and employee awareness.

The role will develop standardised DG policies, training content, competency requirements and compliance monitoring mechanisms while working closely with regional Operations, Safety, Security, Commercial and Customer Service teams to ensure consistent implementation across locations.

The position is envisaged as an individual contributor role with pan-India functional responsibility, requiring strong technical expertise, independent judgement and the ability to influence geographically dispersed stakeholders without direct reporting authority.

The incumbent will also engage with airlines, regulatory authorities, training organisations and relevant industry bodies to strengthen Blue Dart's overall DG compliance and operational safety framework.

Job Purpose:

To establish and implement a robust, standardised Dangerous Goods management framework across Blue Dart's air and ground network, ensuring safe and compliant shipment identification, classification, acceptance, handling and transportation.

The role will focus on minimising undeclared and misdeclared Dangerous Goods shipments, reducing airline interceptions, strengthening operational controls, improving incident and spill management preparedness, and building DG awareness and competency across the organisation.

Through technical expertise, regulatory engagement and cross-functional collaboration, the incumbent will drive a consistent and proactive approach to Dangerous Goods risk management and compliance across the network.

Key Roles & Responsibilities:

Dangerous Goods Governance & Regulatory Compliance


Develop and implement the organisation-wide DG framework covering classification, identification, acceptance, screening, interception and transportation across air and ground operations.Establish and standardise DG policies, SOPs, operational guidelines and escalation procedures in line with applicable IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations, ICAO Technical Instructions, DGCA requirements and relevant ground transport regulations.Define acceptance criteria, shipment restrictions and handling requirements for different categories of Dangerous Goods.Establish controls to identify prohibited, restricted, undeclared or incorrectly declared shipments before they enter the transportation network.Monitor regulatory developments and ensure timely revisions to operational processes and compliance requirements.Provide technical interpretation and guidance to internal stakeholders on DG regulations and shipment acceptance requirements.


DG Risk Prevention & Operational Safety

Experience:

Position Overview:

The Territory Service Representative (TSR) – Operations is responsible for the timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within an assigned territory while delivering a superior customer experience and representing the Blue Dart brand with professionalism.

Operating as the face of Blue Dart on the ground, the role ensures safe handling of shipments, timely collections and deliveries, accurate shipment scanning, COD collections, proof of delivery (POD) compliance and adherence to operational procedures. The TSR works closely with the Shift In-charge and branch operations team to ensure service commitments are consistently achieved while maintaining the highest standards of safety, customer service and operational discipline.

Job Purpose:

To execute timely pickup and delivery of shipments, ensure accurate shipment handling, customer interactions and COD collections while adhering to Blue Dart's operational standards, safety requirements and service commitments.

Key Roles & Responsibilities:

Pickup & Delivery Operations


 Perform timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within the assigned route or territory. Ensure all shipments are delivered within committed service timelines. Verify shipment details before pickup and delivery. Handle shipments carefully to prevent damage or loss. Maintain delivery productivity and route efficiency.


Customer Service Excellence


 Serve as the face of Blue Dart during every customer interaction. Maintain courteous, professional and customer-centric behaviour at all times. Resolve basic customer queries during pickups and deliveries. Escalate customer concerns or operational exceptions promptly. Maintain high standards of grooming, behaviour and professionalism.


COD & Documentation Management


 Collect Cash on Delivery (COD) payments wherever applicable. Ensure accurate cash handling and timely remittance as per company procedures. Obtain Proof of Delivery (POD), customer acknowledgements and required shipment documentation. Ensure documentation accuracy and compliance with operational procedures. Report discrepancies immediately.


Operational Compliance


 Scan shipments accurately using handheld devices or approved digital platforms. Ensure shipment status updates are completed in real time. Follow all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) during pickup and delivery activities. Adhere to company policies relating to shipment handling, documentation and customer interaction. Support operational requirements during peak business periods.


Safety & Security


 Follow all road safety guidelines while operating company or personal vehicles. Ensure safe handling and security of customer shipments throughout transit. Wear the prescribed company uniform and personal protective equipment wherever applicable. Report accidents, incidents or unsafe conditions immediately. Protect company assets and customer property.


Vehicle & Asset Responsibility


 Maintain the assigned vehicle or personal two-wheeler in roadworthy condition. Ensure all statutory vehicle documents remain valid. Maintain cleanliness and basic upkeep of the vehicle. Report maintenance requirements promptly.


Workplace Discipline & Brand Representation


 Maintain high standards of personal grooming, hygiene and professional appearance. Wear the prescribed Blue Dart uniform and identity card while on duty. Demonstrate discipline, punctuality and professionalism at all times. Follow workplace rules, operational discipline and company policies. Represent the Blue Dart brand positively through behaviour, teamwork and commitment to service excellence.


Team Collaboration


 Work closely with Shift In-charges and branch operations teams. Support colleagues during operational contingencies. Participate in operational briefings and safety meetings. Contribute towards achieving branch productivity and service goals.


Qualifications & Experience:

Education:


 Minimum 12th Standard Pass. Higher educational qualifications will be an added advantage.


Experience:


 Fresher or up to 2 years of relevant experience in courier, logistics, distribution, retail delivery or field operations. Experience in pickup and delivery operations will be an added advantage.


Eligibility Requirements:


 Minimum age 18 years. Valid Two-Wheeler or Four-Wheeler Driving Licence. Must own a two-wheeler where deployment requires the employee to use a personal vehicle, in accordance with Company policy. Physically fit to perform field operations. Willingness to work across shifts, weekends and holidays based on business requirements.


Skills & Capabilities:

Technical Skills:


 Pickup & Delivery Operations Shipment Handling Cash Collection (COD) Proof of Delivery (POD) Mobile Device / Scanner Usage Route Familiarity Basic Computer & Mobile Application Skills Basic English Reading & Understanding


Key Competencies:

The role oversees inbound, outbound and transit operations for the eCommerce product, ensuring shipment visibility, network connectivity, service quality and adherence to committed timelines.

Reporting to the Hub Manager, the incumbent works closely with Linehaul Operations, Network Operations, Service Centres, Last Mile Operations and Customer Service teams to ensure efficient hub processing, timely dispatches and effective resolution of operational exceptions. The role plays a critical part in maintaining service reliability, operational efficiency and customer satisfaction for the eCommerce product across the surface logistics network.

Job Purpose:

To manage end-to-end hub operations for the eCommerce product by ensuring timely processing, consolidation and movement of shipments across the surface network, while maintaining operational accuracy, service quality, network connectivity and compliance with organisational standards.

Key Roles & Responsibilities: 

eCommerce Product Operations


 Manage day-to-day operational activities for the eCommerce product within the assigned Surface Hub. Ensure timely receipt, segregation, processing, consolidation and dispatch of eCommerce shipments. Monitor shipment flow across inbound, outbound and transit operations to achieve network timelines. Ensure adherence to operational workflows, product handling standards and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs). Support achievement of product-specific service quality and operational performance targets.


Surface Network Coordination


 Coordinate movement of eCommerce shipments through scheduled surface linehaul and feeder network operations. Ensure timely loading, dispatch and connectivity of shipments to destination hubs and service centres. Monitor adherence to network cut-off timings and dispatch schedules. Coordinate with Network Operations and Linehaul teams to minimise delays and optimise shipment movement. Ensure accurate shipment visibility through timely scanning and system updates.


Shipment Processing & Exception Management


 Monitor scanning, sorting, bagging and dispatch activities to ensure operational accuracy. Proactively identify and resolve shipment exceptions including delays, misroutes, scanning discrepancies and stock lying at hub (SLAH). Coordinate with originating and destination locations to ensure timely closure of operational exceptions. Ensure prompt communication of network disruptions and recovery plans to relevant stakeholders. Drive timely resolution of service issues impacting product performance.


Operational Coordination & Service Performance


 Coordinate daily with Hub Operations, Linehaul, Service Centres, Last Mile Operations and Customer Service teams to ensure seamless operational execution. Monitor daily shipment volumes and support manpower planning based on operational requirements. Track product-specific operational performance and recommend corrective actions to improve service reliability. Support implementation of process improvements and operational best practices across the hub. Prepare operational updates and escalate critical service issues to the Hub Manager in a timely manner.


Service Quality & Operational Excellence

Ensure timely closure of operational exceptions to minimise service failures and improve shipment visibility. Monitor shipment ageing, pending loads and stock lying at hub (SLAH), ensuring timely corrective actions. Drive adherence to scanning compliance, shipment accuracy and operational quality standards. Identify process improvement opportunities to enhance service reliability and operational productivity.


Resource Planning & Hub Coordination

Support daily operational planning based on shipment forecasts, network priorities and hub capacity. Coordinate with transport partners and linehaul teams to ensure timely vehicle placement and dispatch readiness. Ensure optimum utilisation of operational resources to achieve productivity and cost efficiency. Support contingency planning during network disruptions, seasonal peaks and volume surges.


Compliance & Operational Governance

Promote safe handling of shipments and adherence to security protocols across all operational activities. Support internal audits, quality reviews and compliance assessments, ensuring timely closure of observations. Maintain operational records, documentation and system updates in accordance with organisational requirements. Escalate operational risks, compliance gaps and service issues to the Hub Manager on a timely basis.

Position Overview:

The Senior Executive / Assistant Manager – Hub Operations is responsible for managing end-to-end mid-mile operations at an assigned Air Hub or Surface Hub, ensuring seamless movement of shipments across the Blue Dart network. Reporting to the Head – Hub Operations, the incumbent leads shift operations across the hub by coordinating shipment processing, fleet movements, manpower deployment and operational resources. The role works closely with Network Operations, Aviation, Surface Linehaul, Customer Service and Regional Operations teams to ensure network schedules are met, operational exceptions are proactively managed and hub performance supports Blue Dart's service commitments.

Job Purpose:

To manage mid-mile hub operations by ensuring timely movement of shipments across the network, maximising hub productivity, maintaining network connectivity, driving operational excellence and ensuring compliance with organisational standards, safety requirements and service commitments.

Key Roles & Responsibilities:

Hub Operations Management


Lead day-to-day operations across the assigned Air Hub or Surface Hub, ensuring efficient inbound, outbound and transit shipment movement. Ensure adherence to network schedules, operational workflows and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs). Plan daily hub activities based on shipment volumes, network priorities and operational requirements. Ensure optimum utilisation of hub infrastructure, operational resources and manpower. Support the Head – Hub Operations in achieving operational, service quality and productivity objectives. 


Mid Mile Network Operations


Ensure timely receipt, processing, consolidation and dispatch of shipments across the Blue Dart network. Coordinate movement of shipments through scheduled air, surface and feeder networks to maintain network connectivity. Monitor loading, unloading, scanning, tallying and dispatch activities to ensure shipment accuracy. Coordinate vehicle placement and dock activities to minimise turnaround times. Ensure timely movement of priority, premium and time-definite shipments across the network. 


Network Coordination & Exception Management


Monitor adherence to network schedules and proactively manage delays, misconnections, misroutes and operational exceptions. Coordinate with Aviation, Surface Linehaul, Network Operations and Regional Operations teams to resolve operational issues. Ensure timely communication of network disruptions and recovery actions to impacted stakeholders. Monitor stock lying at hub (SLAH) and drive timely clearance of pending shipments. Ensure accurate status updates and operational visibility across all network systems. 


Workforce & Shift Leadership


Lead operational employees, supervisors and outsourced workforce during assigned shifts. Plan manpower deployment based on shipment volumes and operational priorities. Conduct daily shift briefings and communicate operational updates and safety requirements. Monitor workforce productivity, attendance and adherence to operational standards. Support capability building through coaching, training and performance feedback.


Fleet, Capacity & Resource Management


Ensure availability and optimum utilisation of vehicles, trailers and operational equipment to support scheduled network movements. Coordinate with fleet partners and transport vendors to minimise delays and maximise vehicle utilisation. Monitor dock utilisation, bay allocation and turnaround times to improve hub efficiency. Support capacity planning during peak volumes, network changes and seasonal demand fluctuations. Ensure operational readiness of manpower, equipment and infrastructure to meet business requirements. 


Service Quality & Operational Excellence


Drive adherence to network timelines and ensure timely connectivity of shipments across the air or surface network. Monitor shipment accuracy, scanning compliance, loading quality and dispatch integrity to minimise operational errors. Ensure timely closure of operational exceptions, stock lying at hub (SLAH), misroutes and misconnections. Review operational performance trends and implement corrective actions to improve service reliability. Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance hub productivity, service quality and operational efficiency. 


Safety, Security & Compliance


Ensure compliance with organisational policies, operational SOPs, aviation or transportation regulations and statutory requirements. Promote a strong safety culture by ensuring safe handling of shipments, vehicles and operational equipment. Support periodic operational, security and quality audits and ensure timely closure of audit observations. Ensure compliance with all regulatory documentation, shipment security requirements and operational controls applicable to the hub. Identify operational risks and implement preventive measures to ensure uninterrupted hub operations. 


Stakeholder Management & Operational Communication


Coordinate closely with Network Operations, Aviation, Surface Operations, Customer Service, Security and Regional Operations teams to ensure seamless execution. Maintain effective communication with upstream and downstream network locations regarding shipment movements, operational disruptions and recovery plans. Ensure timely escalation of operational risks, capacity constraints and service issues to the Head – Hub Operations. Build collaborative relationships with internal stakeholders and transport partners to improve network performance. Support implementation of organisational initiatives, process changes and operational improvement programmes across the hub. 


People Leadership & Capability Development


Lead, coach and develop supervisors, operational employees and outsourced workforce to achieve operational objectives. Conduct regular shift briefings and ensure effective communication of operational priorities, safety requirements and service expectations. Monitor employee productivity, attendance, discipline and overall team performance. Support implementation of learning initiatives and on-the-job capability development programmes. Foster a culture of accountability, teamwork, continuous improvement and customer focus across the hub.

Assistant Manager – Hub Operations (Grade M): 4 - 7 years of relevant experience with demonstrated experience in leading medium to large hub operations. Experience in managing inbound, outbound and transit operations within an air or surface logistics network. Exposure to fleet coordination, shipment movement, operational planning and network performance management. Experience in leading frontline operational teams and working in high-volume, time-sensitive logistics environments

Reporting to the Hub Manager, the incumbent works closely with Linehaul Operations, Network Operations, Service Centres, Last Mile Operations and Customer Service teams to ensure efficient hub processing, timely dispatches and effective resolution of operational exceptions. The role plays a critical part in maintaining service reliability, operational efficiency and customer satisfaction for the eCommerce product across the surface logistics network.

Job Purpose:

To manage end-to-end hub operations for the eCommerce product by ensuring timely processing, consolidation and movement of shipments across the surface network, while maintaining operational accuracy, service quality, network connectivity and compliance with organisational standards.

Key Roles & Responsibilities:

eCommerce Product Operations


Manage day-to-day operational activities for the eCommerce product within the assigned Surface Hub.Ensure timely receipt, segregation, processing, consolidation and dispatch of eCommerce shipments.Monitor shipment flow across inbound, outbound and transit operations to achieve network timelines.Ensure adherence to operational workflows, product handling standards and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).Support achievement of product-specific service quality and operational performance targets.


Surface Network Coordination


Coordinate movement of eCommerce shipments through scheduled surface linehaul and feeder network operations.Ensure timely loading, dispatch and connectivity of shipments to destination hubs and service centres.Monitor adherence to network cut-off timings and dispatch schedules.Coordinate with Network Operations and Linehaul teams to minimise delays and optimise shipment movement.Ensure accurate shipment visibility through timely scanning and system updates.


Shipment Processing & Exception Management


Monitor scanning, sorting, bagging and dispatch activities to ensure operational accuracy.Proactively identify and resolve shipment exceptions including delays, misroutes, scanning discrepancies and stock lying at hub (SLAH).Coordinate with originating and destination locations to ensure timely closure of operational exceptions.Ensure prompt communication of network disruptions and recovery plans to relevant stakeholders.Drive timely resolution of service issues impacting product performance.


Operational Coordination & Service Performance


Coordinate daily with Hub Operations, Linehaul, Service Centres, Last Mile Operations and Customer Service teams to ensure seamless operational execution.Monitor daily shipment volumes and support manpower planning based on operational requirements.Track product-specific operational performance and recommend corrective actions to improve service reliability.Support implementation of process improvements and operational best practices across the hub.Prepare operational updates and escalate critical service issues to the Hub Manager in a timely manner.


Service Quality & Operational Excellence


Monitor operational performance against defined service level agreements (SLAs) and eCommerce product commitments.Ensure timely closure of operational exceptions to minimise service failures and improve shipment visibility.Monitor shipment ageing, pending loads and stock lying at hub (SLAH), ensuring timely corrective actions.Drive adherence to scanning compliance, shipment accuracy and operational quality standards.Identify process improvement opportunities to enhance service reliability and operational productivity.


Resource Planning & Hub Coordination


Coordinate with the Hub Manager to ensure adequate manpower, equipment and operational resources are available to support daily volumes.Support daily operational planning based on shipment forecasts, network priorities and hub capacity.Coordinate with transport partners and linehaul teams to ensure timely vehicle placement and dispatch readiness.Ensure optimum utilisation of operational resources to achieve productivity and cost efficiency.Support contingency planning during network disruptions, seasonal peaks and volume surges.


Compliance & Operational Governance

Performance Reporting & Continuous Improvement

Bachelor's Degree in any discipline.Certification or Diploma in Logistics, Supply Chain Management or Operations Management will be an added advantage.

3–5 years of experience in courier, express logistics, transportation, eCommerce logistics or hub operations.Experience in managing hub operations, shipment processing or mid-mile logistics within a high-volume environment.Exposure to surface linehaul operations, shipment tracking and operational performance management.Experience in coordinating with multiple internal stakeholders to achieve network and service commitments.Working knowledge of logistics management systems, operational dashboards and Microsoft Office applications.

Position Overview:

The Area Operations Manager is responsible for managing the end-to-end operational performance of a defined cluster of non-metro locations within the Branch geography.

The role oversees multiple Service Centres, Business Development Offices (BDOs), RSP / partner-supported locations and customer-facing counters, ensuring consistent service delivery, workforce productivity, operating discipline and customer experience across the Area.

Acts as the operational link between the Branch Operations Head and location-level Operations teams, translating Branch priorities into effective local execution while ensuring timely pickup, processing, dispatch and delivery of shipments.

The role is accountable for service quality, productivity, manpower deployment, local operating cost, infrastructure readiness, partner performance, safety and compliance across assigned locations.

Job Purpose:

To lead and manage a high-performing cluster of non-metro Operations locations by ensuring reliable service delivery, effective workforce and resource utilization, cost discipline, customer satisfaction and consistent operational standards across Service Centres, BDOs, PUDs and partner-supported locations.

Key Roles & Responsibilities:

Area Operations Leadership


Own operational performance across all assigned locations within the Area. Translate Branch operational priorities into location-level execution plans. Ensure consistent adherence to Blue Dart operating standards and service commitments. Conduct structured daily, weekly and monthly reviews with location Operations teams. Identify underperforming locations and drive focused corrective actions. Ensure operational readiness across locations for daily volumes, peak periods and business growth. Act as the first level of leadership escalation for operational issues across the Area. 


Service Centre & PUD Operations


Oversee pickup and delivery performance across Service Centres and PUD locations. Monitor First Attempt Delivery, NDR, ageing, pickup adherence and route productivity. Ensure adequate manpower and resource deployment across locations. Drive adherence to operational cut-offs and shipment-processing requirements. Review location-level productivity and initiate corrective actions where required. Ensure smooth coordination between Service Centres, PUDs and downstream network nodes. Drive standardisation of operating practices across locations. 


Non-Metro / BDO & Partner Operations


Govern operations across BDOs, RSPs and other partner-supported locations within the Area. Monitor partner / outsourced workforce performance and service adherence. Ensure adequate operating capability in lower-volume and remote locations. Drive corrective action for recurring partner service or productivity gaps. Ensure outsourced locations comply with Blue Dart operational and customer-service standards. Escalate structural vendor or operating-model issues to the Branch Operations Head / Regional RSP-BDO Manager as appropriate. Maintain service continuity in remote and difficult-to-operate markets. 


Shipment Flow & Network Connectivity


Ensure timely inbound and outbound shipment movement across Area locations. Monitor adherence to dispatch, pickup and network cut-offs. Coordinate with Branch, Hub, CPU and Network teams on recurring connectivity issues. Identify shipment accumulation, missed connections and ageing risks. Drive timely resolution of operational exceptions. Support contingency planning during route disruptions, capacity shortages or peak volumes. Ensure timely handover of shipments to upstream and downstream network locations. 


Service Quality & Customer Experience


Drive achievement of defined service-quality targets across the Area. Review customer complaints and recurring operational service failures. Ensure timely root-cause analysis and corrective action. Monitor service trends by location and identify high-risk operating pockets. Partner with Customer Service / Commercial teams on significant customer issues. Ensure customer-facing counters maintain required service and process standards. Reduce repeat service failures through preventive action. 


People & Workforce Management


Lead and guide Service Centre In-charges, Assistant Managers / Operations Managers and local Operations teams. Ensure appropriate staffing across FTE, outsourced and partner-supported locations. Monitor attendance, productivity, attrition and replacement requirements. Coach and develop location Operations leaders. Build adequate bench strength for critical roles. Support workforce planning for peak and seasonal requirements. Drive accountability, discipline and engagement across the Area. 


Cost & Productivity Management


Monitor operating costs across assigned locations. Track cost per shipment, manpower productivity, route productivity and resource utilization. Identify high-cost / low-productivity locations and initiate corrective actions. Ensure adherence to approved operating budgets and cost controls. Support optimisation of routes, manpower and local operating resources. Track OCPM / OCPK and other relevant cost-efficiency metrics where applicable. Deliver cost improvement without compromising service quality. 


Infrastructure & Capacity Management


Assess adequacy of Service Centre, BDO and PUD capacity against shipment volumes. Identify local infrastructure constraints affecting service or productivity. Provide inputs for facility expansion, relocation or capacity enhancement. Ensure operating equipment and facilities remain fit for purpose. Coordinate with Branch / Engineering teams on infrastructure requirements. Ensure peak-volume readiness across assigned locations. 


Compliance, Safety & Operational Governance


Ensure adherence to SOPs, safety, security and statutory requirements. Conduct periodic location visits, floor reviews and compliance checks. Maintain readiness for operational and internal audits. Ensure timely closure of audit observations and process gaps. Monitor shipment security and handling standards. Ensure appropriate controls over cash, documentation and Blue Dart assets where applicable. Promote a strong culture of safety and operational discipline. 


Continuous Improvement & Digital Adoption


Identify recurring operational bottlenecks across Area locations. Drive structured root-cause analysis and improvement actions. Promote adoption of Blue Dart systems, digital tools and dashboards. Standardise proven practices across Service Centres and BDOs. Track benefits from local productivity and service-improvement initiatives. Support implementation of regional / Branch improvement programs. Encourage data-led operating reviews and fact-based decision-making. 


Stakeholder & Governance


Work closely with the Branch Operations Head and location Operations teams. Coordinate with PUD, Hub, CPU, RSP / BDO and regional functional teams as required. Partner with HR on manpower and people issues. Work with Customer Service and Commercial teams on service concerns. Coordinate with Security, IT, Engineering and Finance as required. Provide accurate visibility of Area performance, risks and corrective actions. Represent the Area in Branch-level Operations reviews. 


Qualifications & Experience:


Education: Bachelor’s degree in operations, Supply Chain, Logistics, Business Administration or related discipline; MBA / PG desirable. Experience: 6–9 years of relevant experience in express logistics, courier, eCommerce logistics, 3PL, distribution or multi-location Operations. Experience managing multiple Service Centres / BDOs / non-metro Operations locations preferred. Strong exposure to First Mile and Last Mile Operations. Understanding of pickup, delivery, shipment processing, network cut-offs and service-quality management. Experience managing direct and outsourced workforce. Exposure to partner / franchise / RSP operating models desirable. Experience in manpower productivity, route performance and local operating cost management. Strong understanding of customer service, operational compliance and safety requirements. Demonstrated ability to manage teams across geographically dispersed locations. Preferred Industries: Express Logistics, Courier, eCommerce Logistics, 3PL, Distribution, Transportation and Supply Chain Operations.

Area / Cluster Operations Management Service Centre Operations First & Last Mile Operations PUD Operations RSP / BDO / Partner Operations Shipment Processing & Network Connectivity Route & Delivery Productivity Workforce & Manpower Planning Outsourced Workforce Management Service Quality & Customer Experience Cost per Shipment / OCPM / OCPK Management Capacity & Infrastructure Planning Operational Analytics & MIS Safety, Security & SOP Compliance Root Cause Analysis & Continuous Improvement Data-led Operational Governance
